declarations.name: AuiGantt

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the tree grid; the toolbar is named '{label} controls'. Non-empty.

inputs.name: resources
inputs.description: { id, label, capacity? (percent per working day, default 100) }; assignments must reference them.

inputs.name: calendar
inputs.description: Working days, holidays, and exceptions (default Monday to Friday). Durations and lags count its working days; non-working days are shaded.

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Pointer, keyboard, and toolbar editing (move, resize, link).

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Grid columns: 'name' first, then any of 'start', 'end', 'duration', 'progress', 'resources', 'float' (unique).

inputs.name: showCritical
inputs.description: Mark critical tasks (badge, hatched bar, red connectors).

inputs.name: showBaselines
inputs.description: Draw baselines and describe baseline variance in the grid.

inputs.name: showHistogram
inputs.description: Show the resource load histogram below the chart (needs resources): daily load per resource with peak and over-capacity days as text.

inputs.name: today
inputs.description: Date of the today line and the Go to today button (default: the device's local date).

inputs.name: canEdit
inputs.description: Veto edits of a task (also as a link successor). Summary and read-only tasks are never edited.

inputs.name: rowHeight
inputs.description: Row height in CSS px (24..96). Rows have a fixed height (virtual rows).

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Dates, numbers, the first day of the week (week scale), plural forms, and messages.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Mirrors the timeline and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

models.name: tasks
models.description: Tasks: { id, parentId (summary task id or null), label, start (requested start, PlainDate), duration (working days, 0 = milestone), progress? (0..100), manual?, assignments? ({ resourceId, units? percent }), baseline? ({ start, end } inclusive), color? (1..8), readOnly?, collapsed? }. Tasks with children are summary tasks (their start and duration are ignored). Order within a parent is the array order. Validated (GANTT_OPTIONS). Replacing it clears the undo history.

models.name: dependencies
models.description: { id, from (predecessor), to (successor), type? ('FS' default, 'SS', 'FF', 'SF'), lag? (working days, negative = lead) }. Leaf tasks only, one per pair, no cycles (the error names the cycle).

models.name: scale
models.description: Timeline scale (32, 16, or 5 CSS px per day); also changed by the zoom buttons and setScale().

outputs.name: taskChange
outputs.description: Before a change is applied; preventDefault() keeps the previous state.

outputs.name: expandChange
outputs.description: A summary task was expanded or collapsed.

properties.name: canUndo
properties.description: Read-only: A change can be undone.

properties.name: canRedo
properties.description: Read-only: An undone change can be redone.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Change the scale, keeping the first visible date; emits aui-scale-change.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Expand or collapse a summary task (emits aui-expand-change).

methods.name: scrollToTask
methods.signature: scrollToTask(id: string, options?: { focus?: boolean; } | undefined): void
methods.description: Expand the ancestors, scroll the row and bar into view, and focus the row (unless focus is false).

methods.name: scrollToDate
methods.description: Center the timeline on a date.

methods.name: moveTask
methods.signature: moveTask(id: string, start: PlainDate): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Change the requested start (next working day). Emits aui-task-change; false when refused or cancelled.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.signature: setDuration(id: string, duration: number): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Change the duration in working days (0 = milestone).

methods.name: addDependency
methods.description: Add a dependency (validated; throws GANTT_OPTIONS for cycles or summary tasks); false when the event is cancelled.

methods.name: resourceLoad
methods.signature: resourceLoad(range?: { start: PlainDate; end: PlainDate; } | undefined): GanttResourceLoad[] | undefined
methods.description: Daily load per resource (default: the timeline range).

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo the last change (emits aui-task-change with reason 'undo').

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Treegrid with row focus: rows carry aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset, aria-expanded (summary tasks), and aria-rowindex (virtual rows); one roving tab stop. The grid is the accessible surface: every value a bar shows (dates, duration, milestone, critical, dependencies, violations, baseline variance) is text in its row. The timeline and histogram tracks are aria-hidden pointer surfaces with keyboard and toolbar equivalents for every action (WCAG 2.5.7).

limitations: Scheduling is in whole working days (PlainDate); hours within a day are not modeled.
Dependencies connect leaf tasks only; summary tasks follow their children.
Auto-scheduled tasks start at their requested start or later (as soon as dependencies allow); there are no other constraint types (must finish on, as late as possible).
Resource load is reported, not leveled: over-allocations are shown but not resolved.
Progress is displayed but not edited in the chart.
Pointer drags are not announced step by step (keyboard and toolbar changes are).
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
